title: This Candidate is [MASK] Prompt-based Sentiment Extraction and Reference Letters

bias_targets.methodology: Using prompt-based extraction to compute a 'net-standout' score that measures the relative emphasis of 'standout' versus 'grindstone' personality traits in reference letters, and analyzing the systematic differences in these scores between male and female candidates.

Comparing average prompt-based sentiment polarity scores and simulated job market success probabilities across candidates from different geographic regions of origin (e.g., Asia, Developing Countries, Europe, North America).
